mainEntity.name: When is the best time to consider a whole-house remodel instead of just a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a whole-house remodel if your home's overall layout is inefficient, multiple systems (plumbing, electrical) are outdated, or you desire a completely refreshed aesthetic and functionality throughout the entire property. A room addition is more suitable if you are generally happy with your home but simply need more space in a specific area. A whole-house remodel addresses consistency in design and infrastructure across the entire home, often resulting in a more cohesive and valuable outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a whole-house remodel when multiple systems are outdated or you need a complete aesthetic and functional refresh. A room addition suits specific space needs.
